other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect Overall Metric Aggregation
other_failure_modes.description: The overall validation score is calculated as a global MAE across all predictions, rather than the competition's official metric (the unweighted mean of the log MAE for each individual coupling type). This makes the overall score heavily dominated by coupling types with larger absolute scales, hiding poor performance on smaller-scale types.

summary: The solution is exceptionally strong, featuring deep 3D spatial feature engineering and careful avoidance of target leakage by computing group statistics purely on the training split. The primary flaws are minor: relying on a single validation fold rather than full cross-validation, and aggregating the final validation score as a global MAE instead of the task's proper group-wise Log MAE metric.
